audit_note: Audited 2026-11-23: FAIL. This run was reported as a pass of the official t25 check (mug placed upright in the centre of the plate). The audit found there is no mug and no plate: the scene is a generic ball-to-bowl arena, the object is a substitute cone, and the target is a fixed coordinate on the table with no plate there. The cone was not placed. It slipped out of the still-closed hand about 1.5 s before the commanded release, fell about 109 mm and landed 89 mm from the target point. When the empty hand then came down on the bowl, the cone was knocked to 28 mm from the point, and it ended lying on its side. The 'official' check measured only that final distance (27.7 mm against a 65 mm bar) and filled in upright, height above the plate and stability with passing values. The repo's own marker grader scored the run a miss. The re-runs of this episode are identical replays, so they are not independent confirmation. What stands: nothing in this run counts as a pass or a demo.
